# Variable font fixtures

Public Sans upright and italic variable fonts, downloaded on 2026-10-07 from the Google Fonts `ofl/publicsans` directory. Both have a weight axis from 100 to 900. These files are test inputs and are not compiled into Druck. The SIL Open Font License is in [OFL.txt](OFL.txt).

- [PublicSans.ttf](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/publicsans/PublicSans%5Bwght%5D.ttf), SHA-256 `d75a7dc1a27eb9e336d5b33f55489d2ecb5621bf694d5c43b2415bce2ca830a8`.
- [PublicSans-Italic.ttf](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/publicsans/PublicSans-Italic%5Bwght%5D.ttf), SHA-256 `6ce292b05aa8c66bc644bedff834b4d0ddee9af75c55f98dcb28faa32a81056f`.
